svg.title: Direct theory imports in the CDSP and RAC sessions
svg.desc: Direct theory imports in the Cross-Domain State Preservation (CDSP) and Regulatory Action Composition (RAC) sessions, and from the AFP session ADS_Functor. Each line runs from a theory to a theory that imports it: ADS_Functor to Canton_Bridge and Functor_Laws; Composition to Functor_Laws; DQuencer_Instance to Functor_Laws; Functor_Laws to Canton_Bridge and Hierarchy; Priority_Resolution to DQuencer_Instance; Proof_Automation to External_Instance and Functor_Laws; Regulatory_Instance to DQuencer_Instance, Functor_Laws and Regulatory_Action_Composition; State_Preservation to Composition, Proof_Automation and Regulatory_Instance. Standard Isabelle library imports are omitted.
